answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 52 identities means 52 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the ember pair is tracked in the nebula ledger, the mirror audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 30%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
